message: Hi, my little one Quinn is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hey there! Yes, we do! We have Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for kids ages 4-7, so Quinn would be a perfect fit. It's a great program for that age group. Are you interested in booking a free trial class to see how Quinn likes it?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! Can I grab your email address? That way I can send you the confirmation and class details.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Quinn's full name and date of birth to get the trial booked. What's Quinn's full name?
Quinn's full name is Quinn Pebble, and their birthday is January 30, 2020.
Awesome! I have a couple of spots available for Quinn's trial class. I have Sunday July 12th at 10:00 AM or Monday July 13th at 5:15 PM. Which works better for you?
Let's go with Sunday, July 12th at 10:00 AM. Thank you!

Perfect! Quinn is all set for Sunday, July 12th at 10:00 AM for the free trial class. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.pebble@gmail.com with all the details. Just come in comfortable clothes and we'll take care of the rest. See you then!
